item_short_desc: Illuminate your surroundings with Rothco's Luminous Tape. This tape features a self-adhesive backing for easy application on various surfaces and glows in total darkness for up to 4 hours after exposure to a light source. The glow in the dark tape measures 1 inch x 5 yards, providing sufficient length for multiple applications. Made in the USA, the hi-vis tape is perfect for various applications including helmets, sporting goods, walkways, escape routes, light switches, and more.
